purpose: Teach: フジモリ/立川/杜/ニュートン/ブルガリア/プーケット/ラオス/ユネスコ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフジモリ大統領のドキュメンタリーを観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a documentary about Fujimori the president.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Soft interest in sharing what she noticed. Speaking to her son with the ease of a mother passing along a small family moment. Even pace, gentle attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと立川の昭和記念公園行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to Showa Memorial Park in Tachikawa with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Quick attack on the opening, almost tumbling over words with enthusiasm. A child wanting her to know he did something special. Unselfconscious joy, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鎮守の杜の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to read you a picture book about the shrine forest.
lines.style: Warm notification, slightly formal courtesy tone ('going to'). Speaking as though sharing a gift her husband is offering their son. Measured pace, with quiet pleasure underneath. A moment of quiet anticipation in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとニュートンの伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a biography of Newton with Dad!
lines.style: Immediate, proud report. Slight breathlessness — he's been holding this to tell her. Quick tempo, genuine excitement about sharing what he learned with her. The pride of having done something grown-up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがブルガリア出張のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling us about his business trip to Bulgaria.
lines.style: Gentle, observing tone. Speaking as though she's noticing her son's attention to his father's world. Unhurried pace. A mother sharing the texture of her husband's presence with their son. Warm without insistence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプーケットの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Phuket with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, eager report — rushing slightly to get the words out before his thought moves on. Genuine delight in the shared activity. No pretense, just a six-year-old wanting her to know he was there with Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラオスの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to read you a picture book about Laos.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Measured, unhurried. A mother sharing what her husband plans to do with their son. Quiet pleasure in the anticipation of this moment. Tender but not effusive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとユネスコ世界遺産のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a UNESCO World Heritage documentary with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, warm conclusion. Quick tempo with a satisfied finish. The final report, delivered with the warmth of a child who has been fully present with his father. Open, genuine, no hesitation.
